prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished landscape product-design mockup for the existing Chinese companion desktop app 在场. This is a restrained detail design for reviewing a character's editable personality before adoption, not a new app. Warm ivory paper, fine muted gold lines, calm Chinese typography, generous but useful whitespace, no green UI. At 1440×1000, show the existing simple top navigation 聊天 今天 留下; below a settings tab strip 陪伴的样子 怎么相处 阅读与节奏 连接与资料. Main content: a centered paper-like sheet titled 先看看，再决定. It feels like looking over a thoughtfully written letter together at a sunlit wooden desk, with a subtle window shadow at the outer edge only. No illustration of a human or body anywhere; no avatars required. In the sheet header: 丰川祥子 and a small text action 调整这份设定. On the left a clear editable character introduction under 怎样相处, then 说话的方式, with plausible Chinese prose retaining dignity and teenage liveliness. On the right a small folded-note-like section 称呼: 自称 我, 如何称呼你 小灰灰; visually preserve the user's chosen nickname rather than erase it. Lower right a quiet excerpt area 试着这样说 with the short example 先把你卡住的那一行留在这里，我们接着它看。 At the bottom, sticky separate real-looking buttons 放进编辑草稿 and 先不换. A small local option 使用我们原来的称呼 is checked. No dashboard cards, no gradients across the content, no technical statuses, no progress counters, no all-caps English. Design a clear relationship between the character's own voice and the person's existing chosen nickname: warmth comes from preserving what was already agreed and allowing careful revision, not from reassuring slogans. Show all text readable and controls aligned. This is a design reference; no screenshot of source code, no photorealistic people, no bright green.
